newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhongfu in China hotel venture with HK.
newsitem.headline: Zhongfu in China hotel venture with HK.

text.p: Fujian Zhongfu Industrial Co Ltd and a Hong Kong-based firm have signed an agreement to build a 200 million yuan (($24.1 million) hotel in China's eastern city of Suzhou, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Friday.

Zhongfu would have a 30 percent stake in the four-star hotel by contributing land, while the remaining 70 percent would be held by Eastern Dragon Holdings (Bermuda) Ltd, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
A spokeswoman for Zhongfu told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that construction would begin in early 1997 and be completed in two years. She gave no further details.
Zhongfu, based in Fuzhou, capital of the southeastern province of Fujian, listed 38.60 million A shares on the Shenzhen bourse in March.
